business_rule: No resource time overlap incl conflict group
Agreement signing converts reservation via Saga
EXPIRED/TERMINATED is not CLOSED until operational/financial closure
Client success is not payment truth; UNKNOWN query-before-retry
Collection + Receivable + Allocation + Ledger local strong tx
Deposit is liability and independently settled
Invoice quota prevents over-invoicing; red flush restores quota
SMS/email/in-app reminder delivery is idempotent and audited
AP payout cannot exceed payable and UNKNOWN is queried
Owner settlement sources consumed once and pay through AP
